requirements.title: Remote profile management
requirements.statement: The eUICC shall support remote profile management over SMS and HTTPS.

requirements.title: Update profile metadata over SMS
requirements.statement: The eUICC shall apply an ES6.UpdateMetadata command received over the SMS secure OTA channel within 5 seconds.

requirements.title: Reject unsigned profiles
requirements.statement: The eUICC shall reject a profile whose signature does not verify.
